name: Sylvester Manor
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Gene Casey & the Lone Sharks - show calendar. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Outdoor concerts are on the grounds (a low portable stage on the lawn in the site's photo); no dance floor is described. The header logo on the site is a white 'knockout' version; the same logo in color (same folder, SM-logo-color-stacked.png) was used instead. The farmstand is at a separate address, 21 Manwaring Road. The site lists a P.O. Box 2029 mailing address as well as the street address.
hours: Trails and grounds: daily, sunrise to sunset, March-October
description: A 236-acre historic farm and nonprofit on Shelter Island with walking trails, an 1810 windmill and a working farm. It holds outdoor concerts and other cultural events on its grounds.

logo.alt: Sylvester Manor logo: a blue windmill above plowed fields over the words Sylvester Manor

photos.alt: Two musicians with a guitar and harmonica playing on a low outdoor stage on the Manor's shady lawn
Visitors standing outside the open door of the shingled 1810 windmill at Sylvester Manor

evidence.note: Nonprofit's own site footer: Post Office Box 2029, 80 North Ferry Road, Shelter Island, NY 11964, info@sylvestermanor.org, 631.749.0626, with Facebook, Twitter, YouTube and Instagram links.
Trails and grounds are open March-October, seven days a week, sunrise to sunset.
Fall Concert on Sat Oct 10, 2026, 2-5 PM: Gene Casey & the Lone Sharks plus The Hoodoo Loungers, a fundraiser for the Shelter Island Fire Department.
